observations: Black game console with a glossy top panel and a matte bottom panel.
Two DualShock 4 controllers: one red and one light blue/silver.
A black power cable is visible in both photos.
The console has visible scuffs and scratches on the top surface.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the front of the console in photo 1.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'YUNG HITCH' are present on both images.

claims.evidence: The console is shown in photos, but the origin and model are not explicitly confirmed.
Photo 0 shows significant scuffing and wear on the top surface of the console.
No game discs or cases are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of both controllers being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of both controllers being used to navigate the system menu.
Photo of the system storage showing the number of installed games.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
